√prach 'ask'
present: [6.] pṛcháti pṛcháte etc. V.+ 
perfect: papracha paprachus B.+ 
aorist: [3.] apaprachat -- [4.] áprākṣīt etc. V.+ áprāṭ apraṣṭa pṛkṣase? 
future: [1.] prakṣyati etc. B.+ aprakṣyat -- [2.] praṣṭā 
verbal: pṛṣṭá V.+ práṣṭum V.+ pṛṣṭvā E.+ -pṛchya E.+ -pṛ́cham pṛṣṭvā 
secondary: passive: pṛchyáte etc. V.+ -- intensive: parīpṛch- -- desiderative: pipṛchiṣa- -- causative: prachaya- 
derivatives: -pṛch prāch- E.+ pṛchā C. pṛchaka B.+ pṛ́chya RV.C. praṣṭavya E.+ praṣṭṛ U.+ praśná V.+ -praśnya B. pipṛchiṣu C. papṛkṣéṇya RV. prā́ś AV. pipṛkṣu C. 
The RV. form papṛkṣé is also referred hither by BR.

√prath 'spread'
present: [1.] práthate etc. V.+ práthati etc. V.+ 
perfect: paprathé etc. V.+ paprathatus 
aorist: [1.] prathāná -- [3.] papráthat etc. papráthanta -- [5.] aprathiṣṭa etc. 
[future: prathiṣyate prathitā ]
verbal: prathita E.+ 
secondary: causative: pratháyati etc. V.+ pratháyate etc. práthayi 
derivatives: -pṛth? pṛthá B.+ pṛ́thak V.+ pṛ́thavāna RV. pṛ́thi V.B. pṛ́thī V.B. pṛthú V.+ pṛthivī́ V.+ prathā C. práthana B.+ práthas V.B. prathu E.+ prathimán RV.C. práthiṣṭha V.B. práthīyas B.S. prathasnu? TB. prathayitṛ C.

√prā 'fill'
present: [2.] prā́si 
perfect: papraú etc. paprā́tha paprā papre etc. 
aorist: [1.] aprāt etc. aprāyi -- [4.] aprās (3s.) 
verbal: prātá 
derivatives: -prā -pra AV.B.S. -prā́ṇa -prā́van RV. 
A secondary root-form, from √1pṛ.
